name: stifling-trap-memory-alt-cost-declined-keeps-counters
notes: Stifling Trap (z5exbwdp7q): "[Class Bonus] If it's not your turn, you may remove two preparation counters from your champion to activate this card from your memory without paying its reserve cost." Decline case ("you may"); a control that passes with or without the fix (before the fix the window never opened, and the unanswerable PASS is a no-op), so it pins the decline end state rather than the fix. Player 1's champion is Tristan, Hired Blade (ASSASSIN, so the Class Bonus is active) with exactly 2 preparation counters; player 2 has a seeded Dungeon Guide on its field (the Trap's target) and plays another Dungeon Guide from hand on its own turn, which opens a priority window for player 1. Stifling Trap sits in memory and is offered in player 2's Dungeon Guide window, but player 1 passes: nothing is paid or activated -- both preparation counters stay, the Trap stays in memory, nothing hits the seeded Dungeon Guide and the Dungeon Guide resolves normally (player 2 then answers its own On Enter prompt).

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] If it's not your turn, you may remove two preparation counters from your champion to activate this card from your memory without paying its reserve cost.
